keyFindings: The approved 2026–2027 MISOC structure includes Designing Social Research despite omission in the prospectus overview.
Public governance, politics, law, sociology, economics, organisation and empirical methods constitute sustained directly relevant inquiry in the first UCR route.
Climate and sustainability governance provides a second supported option with complementary environmental and technical components, which are distinguished from public-policy courses.
Migration, development, dedicated policy analysis and the required bachelor project remain specialist gaps.
Four weak trace formulations on scientific/technology components were qualified using enriched workbook evidence.
Original canonical comparison is archived unchanged. Prior root decision did not exist; regenerated v2 decision is a new recovery, not a replay of a historical decision.
